notes: EVA-229 step 1A suite (pre-launch amendment 2, gate 10). Six evals: two on what /design SAYS, four on `evie-kit design doctor` behavior against fixtures. Graded by script where mechanical (grade_runs.py beside this file, the EVA-5 pattern); the with-skill arm must pass every expectation, the without-skill arm is run once and recorded.

evals.name: explain-three-layers-and-attribution
evals.expected_output: An explanation naming the three layers (upfront design decisions, design gates inside goals, the method), stating that step 1A ships the verified pinned instrument and `evie-kit design doctor`, naming what is NOT yet available (the migrated review lanes / step 1B, onboarding, gates), and crediting both impeccable (Paul Bakaus, Apache-2.0) and intent (CC0).
expectations: Names all three layers: upfront design decisions, design gates inside goals, and the method
States what step 1A ships (the verified pinned impeccable instrument and/or `evie-kit design doctor`)
Names at least one thing not yet available (step 1B lanes, onboarding, gates, preview, or live mode)
Credits impeccable (pbakaus/impeccable or Paul Bakaus, Apache-2.0)
Credits intent (ghaida/intent, CC0)

evals.name: instrument-absent-points-at-setup
evals.prompt: /design is impeccable set up in this project?
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor (or inspects the project), reports that no committed identity exists, points at `evie-kit setup` as the cure, and does not claim that any design review, audit or critique ran.
expectations: States that the instrument identity (.evie-kit/design/instrument.json) is absent or the instrument is not set up
Points at `evie-kit setup` as the cure
Does not claim a design review, audit, critique or detect scan ran

evals.name: doctor-matching-identity-reports-identity
evals.prompt: /design run the design doctor here and tell me the resolved identity
evals.expected_output: Runs `evie-kit design doctor`, reports exit 0, and relays the resolved identity: CLI version 4.1.0, engine digest (0d48b6e1… on darwin-arm64 or the fixture's), playbook closure digest.
expectations: Runs `evie-kit design doctor` (the command appears in the transcript)
Reports the CLI version from the identity (4.1.0)
Reports the engine digest prefix from the doctor output
Reports the playbook closure digest prefix from the doctor output
Reports exit code 0 / READY

evals.name: doctor-altered-playbook-refuses-naming-file
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor; reports the playbooks row failed, names the mismatched file (reference/audit.md), relays the removal cure, and reports a nonzero exit.
expectations: Runs `evie-kit design doctor`
Reports the playbooks row as failed / NOT READY
Names the mismatched file (reference/audit.md)
Reports a nonzero exit code (1)
Relays the cure (remove the named store directory and re-acquire) rather than deleting anything itself

evals.name: doctor-mise-absent-skipped-never-green
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor with mise unavailable on PATH; reports the mise and cli rows as skipped (not ok), reports exit 2 / UNVERIFIED, and does not describe the instrument as fully ready.
expectations: Runs `evie-kit design doctor`
Reports the mise row as skipped (not green/ok)
Reports exit code 2 or the UNVERIFIED verdict
Does not describe the instrument as fully ready

evals.name: acquire-offline-unavailable-with-cure
evals.prompt: /design acquire the design instrument here (this machine has no network)
evals.expected_output: Runs `evie-kit design acquire --offline` (or acquire, which fails with network refused); reports the assets unavailable with the rerun cure, and confirms nothing partial was published to the store.
expectations: Runs `evie-kit design acquire`
Reports the acquisition as unavailable / failed
Relays the cure (re-run with network access)
States or shows that nothing partial was published (the store has no identity directory)
